title: Tests: IpnsPublisher build_index_json and admin endpoint
description: Unit tests for build_index_json in ipns_publisher.rs: 1. Empty BTreeMap produces {"version":1,"groups":{}}. 2. Two groups in BTreeMap produce correct alphabetically-ordered JSON (BTreeMap guarantees key order). 3. CIDs are encoded as their string representation. Integration test in tests/ipns_admin.rs: seed articles for two groups in DB, call build_ipns_json(), parse returned JSON, verify groups key contains both groups. Admin /ipns tests do not need a live IPFS node — test build_ipns_json() helper function directly. Independent oracle: construct expected JSON strings by hand, not via serde round-trip through the code under test.
